verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an analytics SaaS, for example bulk-managing many sites, goals or properties at once. The evidence shows none. Multi-filtering the dashboard and the consolidated view are viewing and filtering features, not batch actions. CSV import/export moves data rather than acting on many items, and the Stats API is read-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
